messages:
eva_partners: Heads-up: EU SI onboarding this quarter exposed two recurring blockers: (1) voucher->VAR parity (some EU VARs require EORI/tax docs) and (2) private enclave onboarding for regulated customers — mentors need a clear short runbook. Can we produce a compact playbook for both?

 tom_ops: Seen it. Also add a tiny pre-flight for enclave sites: cert thumbprint, firewall allowlist, and a recovery image location. Mentors keep asking where to check certs.

 zara_enable: I can draft a 1-page playbook: Mentor shift rota, voucher parity appendix, enclave pre-flight checklist, and a 2-step escalation. Keep it one sheet with copyable Slack snippets.

 omar_market: I'll map voucher SKUs to VAR offer IDs across EU (DE/FR/IT/ES/NL) and flag which require EORI or VAT upfront. Will include a sample vendor email and CSV.

 si-assist-bot: Task created: #EU-43012 "EU SI voucher & enclave playbook" assigned to zara_enable + omar_market, due 2024-10-15.

 eva_partners: Great. For mentor gating: partners ask if mentors must be certified to touch private deployments. My recommendation: yes — a lightweight "Enclave Ready" badge: 2h training + 30-min proctored practical where mentor runs the pre-flight and demonstrates an enclave model pull. Badge tied to voucher redemptions for private flows.

 tom_ops: Agree. Also require mentors to demonstrate ability to redact PII logs before escalation. Add a 3-step checklist for safe log collection.

 zara_enable: Badge rubric idea: (1) theory 20 min, (2) hands-on 30 min (run checklists + fix a simulated driver mismatch), (3) proctor signs off. Badge valid 12 months. I'll add renewal rules.

 omar_market: Voucher parity notes: some VARs show up as separate local_offer_id in the marketplace; we need mapping to ensure voucher tokens are accepted by the reseller portal. I'll include a boolean column 'reseller_accepts_voucher'.

 tom_ops: For enclave pre-flight, short list for mentors to run on arrival: check cert thumbprint, verify registry connectivity, verify firewall egress to S3 endpoints, confirm disk image checksum, run quick inference smoke test. If any fail -> stop.

 zara_enable: I'll paste a tiny validation script in the playbook mentors can run (one-liner). Also add a plain-language snippet mentors can send to partners if they need someone non-technical to run checks.

 zara_enable: Script snippet (will be in doc):

```
#!/bin/bash
openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/certs/enclave-cert.pem -noout -fingerprint && 
curl -fS https://assets.redwood/model-smoke.tar.gz -o /tmp/m.tar.gz && 
sha256sum /tmp/m.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
```

 omar_market: I'll provide CSV: sku, local_offer_id, country, reseller_accepts_voucher, tax_docs_required. Also include sample vendor email to speed customs:

```
Hi VendorTeam, voucher CODE-XXXX will be redeemed for delivery to [address]. Please confirm if EORI/VAT or other docs are required and estimated customs hold time. Regards.
```

 tom_ops: Escalation routing for private-enclave incidents: mentor -> partner-success (30m) -> security (2h) -> eng-runtime (4h). Add required fields for an incident ticket: site id, cert thumbprint, last 3 validation outputs, and sample redacted logs.

 zara_enable: I'll add a 'first-10' triage card mentors can paste into a ticket to ensure consistent reporting. Example:

```
Site: <site-id>\nContact: <partner-contact>\nValidation outputs: <attach>\nIssue: node failed during model pull, error code 504
Actions tried: cert verify, curl asset, restarted docker
```

 eva_partners: Operational ask: can we maintain a shared sheet with columns: cohort, mentor, badge_status, voucher_code, vendor, interop_passed? Prefer auto-appends from marketplace webhook on voucher redemption.

 omar_market: I can add webhook integration to append redeemed vouchers (will need a service account). Will flag 'manual redemption' rows where VAR portal requires manual vendor acceptance.

 si-assist-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled: EU SI playbook review  2024-10-17 09:00 UTC. Invite sent.

 tom_ops: Timeline: draft playbook pages by 2024-10-09 so we can iterate with legal and security. Badge flow + proctor rubric by 2024-10-09 as well.

 zara_enable: I'll aim for draft by 10/09. Will include three Slack snippets mentors can copy: (1) partner preflight request (plain), (2) vendor voucher confirmation (formal), (3) mentor shift handoff.

 omar_market: CSV and sample vendor email by 10/07.

 eva_partners: One more: add retention policy note for logs (how long mentors should keep redacted logs) and link to privacy policy. Legal wants a default 90-day retention for troubleshooting artifacts.

 tom_ops: noted. I'll draft triage + retention text.

 zara_enable: Confirming owners and due dates in-thread: playbook pages + snippets = zara_enable by 2024-10-09; voucher CSV + mappings = omar_market by 2024-10-07; webhook/sheet plan = tom_ops by 2024-10-11.

 si-assist-bot: Actions recorded: #EU-43012 assigned; review meeting 2024-10-17.

 eva_partners: Thanks team. Please drop drafts in this thread and tag me for legal review. If anyone hits blockers DM me. End.
